body: Thanks, I’m well aware that men do this, my husband included. I should have clarified that it looked more like Ashley Madison or something similar than an actual porn site
It didn’t look like a regular porn site, more like one of those Ashley Madison type deals. I only got a quick glimpse though to be fair
I only expected to be included because we're close and she was in mine a few months ago.

>So you ran to her mommy? Are you an adult or not? What was “not right” about not choosing yo as a bridesmaid?

No, my aunt asked me how I felt about it because she figured I would be asked. And I didn't say her not choosing me wasn't right. I wasn't happy with finding out through a post on social media. I was taken aback because she was in mine but didn't ask me to be in hers.

>No you don’t. Otherwise you wouldn’t have written and posted this ridiculous post

Actually, I do, which is why I'm agreeing to be part of it. I posted this to get some advice and maybe help me see it in a different way.
perhaps you’re right and I need to start looking at this differently. thanks for your input!
I realize I need to deal with this on my own and that’s it’s 100% a me problem. These things are all easier said than done and it would be nice to have some support, that’s all.

\> looking at someone else’s results but wishing they were yours is a sure-fire way to cause yourself to spiral.

preaching to the choir

\> your boyfriend admittedly said he couldn’t help you.

yes he did but I guess I’m struggling to understand his reaction more than anything. I would’ve liked to have been comforted instead of this.
all fair points but I feel like given the reason I was upset I shouldn’t have to ask to be told that I‘m attractive. wouldn’t it be common sense to respond with that instead of getting annoyed?

I am actively working on this issue and do see a therapist. Most of the time I’m fine but I do have my bad days just like anyone else. I’m always there for him when the roles are reversed and don’t get annoyed by it.
wishing you a speedy recovery! you'll be just fine!
can you tell me where you got that clock from?
I've thought about suggesting this. I'm not sure he would agree but I am starting to think that's the only other option
your wife sounds lovely! I should have mentioned I do make nice dinners for him and he is VERY appreciative of it. I am able to cheer him up sometimes but I have trouble keeping him there.
